description: This file contains unit tests for the schema parsing and compatibility checking functionalities within the PyTorch framework, particularly focusing on torch._C.parse_schema and related schema comparison methods.

classes.name: TestFunctionSchema
classes.description: A test suite class deriving from unittest.TestCase that validates various aspects of schema parsing, comparison, backward compatibility, and serialization within PyTorch.

methods.name: test_serialize_and_deserialize(self)
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of schemas, ensuring parsed schemas match originals and backward compatibility assertions.

methods.name: test_out_schema(self)
methods.description: Checks parsing of schemas with 'out' parameters and verifies the 'is_out' attribute.

methods.name: test_hash_schema(self)
methods.description: Validates hashing consistency and differences across various schemas.

methods.name: test_backward_compatible_structure(self)
methods.description: Tests backward compatibility between schemas with different naming or structure changes.

methods.name: test_backward_compatible_outputs(self)
methods.description: Verifies backward compatibility behaviors concerning output types and optionality.

methods.name: test_backward_compatible_arguments(self)
methods.description: Tests argument addition, removal, position change, default value changes, and argument renaming effects on backward compatibility.

methods.name: test_backward_compatible_with_smart_serialization(self)
methods.description: Checks backward compatibility logic for schemas with 'out' arguments, default values, and argument positioning.

methods.name: test_string_optional_parameter_default_value(self)
methods.description: Ensures schemas with optional string parameters are parsed and serialized correctly.

methods.name: test_forward_compatible_arguments_without_out(self)
methods.description: Validates forward compatibility of argument modifications, including deletions, additions, default value updates, and positional changes.

methods.name: test_forward_compatible_arguments_real_use_case(self)
methods.description: Checks a real-world schema change that affects forward compatibility.

methods.name: test_forward_compatible_arguments_with_out(self)
methods.description: Tests forward compatibility in schemas that involve 'out' arguments and argument modifications.

methods.name: test_schema_error(self)
methods.description: Ensures that invalid schemas, such as ones with vararg default values, raise appropriate exceptions.

methods.name: test_tensor_list_alias_annotation_properly_parsed(self)
methods.description: Verifies that tensor list alias annotations are correctly parsed and reflected in the schema.

methods.name: test_tensor_option_arguments_properly_parsed(self)
methods.description: Checks parsing of optional tensor arguments with various types like ScalarType?, Layout?, Device?, etc.

methods.name: test_sym_int_argument_properly_parsed(self)
methods.description: Tests parsing of schemas with symbolic integer arguments and their return types.
